map.按字节与密钥做异或，支持文本 / 十六进制 / Base64 三种输入与输出格式: XOR byte-by-byte with a key; supports text / hexadecimal / Base64 for both input and output
map.加解密是同一运算，重复一次即得回原文: Encryption and decryption are the same operation—applying it again recovers the original
map.可直观演示流密码原理与密钥复用的风险: Visually demonstrates stream-cipher principles and the risk of key reuse
map.适合短数据混淆，不具备现代密码的强度: Suited to short-data obfuscation; not as strong as modern ciphers
map.按字节与密钥异或的对称流密码，密钥复用等同一次性密码本才安全。: A symmetric stream cipher that XORs bytes with a key; key reuse is safe only if it equals a one-time pad.
map.演示流密码的基本原理：理解为何「密钥长度等于明文且只用一次」才安全，以及复用密钥: Demonstrates stream-cipher basics: why "key length equals plaintext and used only once" is required for safety, and why reusing a key can be broken.

map.填写密钥；教学演示可先用单字节密钥观察规律: Enter the key; for teaching, start with a single-byte key to observe the pattern
map.选择输出格式，十六进制便于逐字节核对: Choose the output format; hexadecimal helps verify byte-by-byte
map.点加密得到结果；把结果原样粘回输入框再点一次即可还原: Click encrypt to get the result; paste the result back and click once more to recover the original
map.注意：同一密钥加密两段明文时，两段密文异或即得两段明文异或，切勿复用密钥: Note: when one key encrypts two plaintexts, XORing the two ciphertexts yields XOR of the two plaintexts—never reuse the key
map.XOR 为什么不能单独用于保密？: Why can't XOR alone be used for secrecy?
map.若密钥短且复用，可被频分析与已知明文攻破。: If the key is short and reused, it can be broken by frequency analysis and known-plaintext attacks.
map.复用密钥会被怎么破解？: How is a reused key broken?
map.因为异或可消去：C1 ⊕ C2 = (P1 ⊕ K) ⊕ (P2 ⊕ K) =: Because XOR cancels: C1 ⊕ C2 = (P1 ⊕ K) ⊕ (P2 ⊕ K) = P1 ⊕ P2, eliminating the key entirely. An attacker XORs the two ciphertexts and, using natural-language statistics (e.g., spaces and common letter pairs), can gradually recover the plaintext. This is exactly why many historical "one-time pad reused" leaks occurred.
